- Labs: CBC and metabolic panel normal. HbA1c 5.2% (normal). Lipids: total 191, LDL 118 mg/dL (mildly elevated), HDL 54, TG 112.

- Primary care routine visit: Annual follow-up — around 28 Nov 2026 (per Dr. Moretti’s plan).
